method.latency_aggregation: Median of per-batch percentiles; not pooled percentiles.
method.migration: Three alternating old/new blocks; two measured runs per size/block plus a discarded warmup. Six samples per size/variant.
method.source: Identical Capstan source; only locked dependency revisions differ.

interpretation.overall: No broad end-to-end speedup from dependency replacement alone. Primary scalar results vary by concurrency; four-core affinity confirmation is close to flat, with a small single-connection worker decrease. Some large Paste medians improve; Cut is essentially unchanged.
interpretation.decision: Keep the repository dependency lock unchanged; candidate revisions are recorded for follow-up profiling.
